info.description: Every session of one category belonging to this page's event, with a filtration widget beside it. This is what a category listing page is made of.

__.note: Admin metadata for this schema. Strapi ignores this key; src/this/admin-metadata reads it and writes it into the content manager's stored configuration on every boot.

edit.label: Category
edit.description: Which kind of session this page lists. Every one of them belonging to this page's event is shown — there is no count, because a visitor narrows the list down with the filters rather than being handed a shortened one.
